Production of which game set was maximum from year 2002 to 2004?
solution:
**Given:**

Annual production data of various game sets from 2002 to 2004.

**Formula used:**

Maximum production = Highest number among the production values for each game set over the years 2002, 2003, and 2004.

**Calculations:**

Ludo: 180 (2002), 195 (2003), 220 (2004) ⇒ Maximum = 220

Scrabble: 175 (2002), 160 (2003), 185 (2004) ⇒ Maximum = 185

Chess: 92 (2002), 120 (2003), 130 (2004) ⇒ Maximum = 130

Monopoly: 110 (2002), 125 (2003), 135 (2004) ⇒ Maximum = 135

Carom: 85 (2002), 75 (2003), 80 (2004) ⇒ Maximum = 85

**∴ The maximum production from 2002 to 2004 was for Ludo with 220 units in 2004.**
